message: The other day, I was in the kitchen, trying to whip up dinner while keeping an eye on the kids. Suddenly, I smelled something a little too crispy! Turns out, I had forgotten about the garlic bread in the oven. Thankfully, our smoke alarm did its job and went off before things got out of hand. 😅 It reminded me how important it is to have working smoke alarms and a solid escape plan. Sometimes, those small wins in fire safety can really save the day! Have you checked your alarms lately?
